statements.manual_conversion_rationale: PostgreSQL does not support SCOPE_IDENTITY(). The RETURNING clause provides equivalent functionality. The multi-statement transaction block structure is not supported by DMS for conversion, requiring manual decomposition into separate SQL statements to be executed within an application-managed transaction.

required_code_changes.description: The InsertProductAsync method must be refactored to handle the RETURNING clause from the INSERT statement. The method should execute the INSERT and capture the returned productid, then use it in subsequent INSERT and UPDATE statements within the same transaction.

UpdateProductAsync, DeleteProductAsync methods must wrap their multi-statement operations in explicit application-level transactions using NpgsqlTransaction. The SQL statements have had BEGIN TRANSACTION/COMMIT removed.

Methods that retrieve values for use in subsequent statements (UpdateProductAsync, DeleteProductAsync) need to execute SELECT statements first and capture results before executing UPDATE/INSERT/DELETE operations.
